title: Apartment in Mall World
content: I just found out about this and it's blowing my mind. Sometimes I dream that I live in different apartments in Mall World. The Mall has all these tropical plants around and it's inside a dome. There is a gym, event space, playground and other activities. Like a mini city with apartments in between stores. Sometimes I live in the fancy apartment where there is even a lazy river and sometimes I'm in the smaller low income apartments. In both I dream of re-arranging the space over and over again and I'm always just moving in. The apartments also often share doors. The top of the building also always has a party going on and you can go down a slide. Sometimes it's a Gatsby party, other times a Victorian party. It changes decades but it always has a steampunk vibe. And there is a hotel space but I don't like the elevators going there, they always get stuck or go too fast or they're so small I'm crampped in there 😭
